F. No. Stds/SP(SCSSH)/Ice lollies notification/FSSAI-2018.—Whereas the draft regulations,
namely, the Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Amendment
Regulations, 2018, was published vide notification of the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
number F.No. Stds/SP(SCSSH)/Ice lollies notification/FSSAI-2018, dated the 15th   May, 2018, in the Gazette
of India, Extraordinary, Part III, Section 4 as required under sub- section (1) of section 92 of the Food Safety
and Standards Act, 2006 (34 of 2006), inviting objections and suggestions from persons likely to be affected
thereby, within a period of thirty days from the date on which the copies of the Official Gazette containing the
said notification were made available to the public;
And Whereas the copies of the said Gazette were made available to the public on the 21st May, 2018;
And Whereas the objections and suggestions received from the public in respect of the said draft
regulations have been considered by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India;
Now, Therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by clause (e) of sub- section (2) of section 92
read with section 16 of the said Act, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India hereby makes the
following regulations further to amend the Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food
Additives) Regulations, 2011, namely:-

Regulations
1.
(1) These regulations may be called the Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food
Additives) Seventh Amendment Regulations, 2018.
(2) They shall come into force on the date of their final publication in the official Gazette.
2.
In the Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011, in
regulation 2.7, in sub-regulation 2.7.5, in clause 1,
(1) In first paragraph, after the words “fruit juices, cocoa”, the following shall be inserted, namely:-
“spices and condiments”
(2) In second paragraph, after the words “nuts and salt”, the following shall be inserted, namely:-
“spices and condiments”
PAWAN AGARWAL, Chief Executive Officer
[ADVT.-III/4/Exty./153/18]
